free_tier.stated: Historic operator statement: 100 GB total platform storage, individual uploads up to 50 MB, with the explicit goal of 'supporting data uploads which will make it much simpler for smaller organizations to participate'.

limits_note: per-object-cap 50 MB — chunk-sized, not object-sized. Even if the instance were reachable, 50 MB/file and a 100 GB shared pool would need ~10,000 objects and would blow the pool.
